topic: Muscle loss after 30 and strength training
hook_tts: [surprised] After thirty, your body starts losing muscle. [warmly] And most women have no idea.
hook_caption_split: After 30, your body starts losing muscle.
And most women have no idea.

lines.tts: Research suggests we lose roughly three to eight percent of our muscle every decade after thirty.
lines.caption: Research suggests we lose roughly 3 to 8% of our muscle every decade after 30.

lines.tts: And around menopause, falling estrogen can speed that up.
lines.caption: And around menopause, falling estrogen can speed that up.

lines.tts: Less muscle means weaker bones, a slower metabolism… and a higher risk of falls later in life.
lines.caption: Less muscle means weaker bones, a slower metabolism, and a higher risk of falls later in life.

lines.tts: [warmly] The good news? Strength training works at any age.
lines.caption: The good news? Strength training works at any age.

lines.tts: Two or three sessions a week. Squats, push-ups, resistance bands, dumbbells. It doesn't have to be a gym.
lines.caption: Two or three sessions a week. Squats, push-ups, bands, dumbbells. It doesn't have to be a gym.

topic: Perimenopause signs nobody warns you about
hook_tts: [warmly] If you're in your late thirties or forties and you just don't feel like yourself… [softly] it might not be stress.
hook_caption_split: If you're in your late 30s or 40s and don't feel like yourself...

lines.tts: Perimenopause, the run-up to menopause, can start years before your periods stop. And a lot of women miss the signs.
lines.caption: Perimenopause can start years before your periods stop. A lot of women miss the signs.

lines.tts: One: brain fog. Losing words, forgetting why you walked into a room.
lines.caption: One: brain fog. Losing words, forgetting why you walked into a room.

lines.tts: Two: waking up at three a.m. and not getting back to sleep.
lines.caption: Two: waking up at 3am and not getting back to sleep.

lines.tts: Three: anxiety or irritability that seems to come out of nowhere.
lines.caption: Three: anxiety or irritability out of nowhere.

lines.tts: Four: periods getting heavier, lighter, closer together, or further apart.
lines.caption: Four: periods getting heavier, lighter, closer together or further apart.

lines.tts: These can have other causes too, so track your symptoms and take the list to your doctor. [warmly] You deserve answers.

topic: Tired all the time: iron, thyroid, vitamin D
hook_tts: [warmly] If you're exhausted all the time… stop telling yourself it's just being busy.
hook_caption_split: Stop telling yourself it's just being busy.

lines.tts: There are a few common, very checkable reasons behind it, especially for women.
lines.caption: There are a few common, very checkable reasons, especially for women.

lines.tts: One: iron. Heavy periods can quietly drain your iron stores. Ask about ferritin, not just a basic blood count.
lines.caption: One: iron. Heavy periods can drain your stores. Ask about ferritin.

lines.tts: Two: thyroid. An underactive thyroid is much more common in women, and can cause tiredness, weight changes, and feeling cold.
lines.caption: Two: thyroid. An underactive thyroid is more common in women.

lines.tts: Three: vitamin D. Especially if you don't get much sun for half the year.
lines.caption: Three: vitamin D. Especially if you don't get much sun.

lines.tts: Don't start megadosing supplements. Get tested first, then fix what's actually low.
lines.caption: Don't megadose supplements. Get tested first, then fix what's actually low.
